title.narrative: We!Are – Creative community engagement on climate action

description.narrative:
The project aims to give a voice to young people in marginalised and vulnerable communities and thus showcase to world leaders under the COP27, through creative means, how civil society gets affected by climate change.
To engage local communities in climate action in an accessible and understandable manner through bottom-up campaigns.
To build public opinion and awareness of African-led, low-carbon climate solutions and development pathways that can create thriving and resilient communities in the lead up to COP27.
